title: 第3081章 灭天令的强大威势第3080章 灭天令器灵神魂姜无
content_zh:
“阴森恶狱，令行八方！”
一声怒喝，从姜无的口中发出。
“轰！”
再这一刻，这片周围的虚空空气，都仿佛凝滞了一瞬，让人感到压抑，像是有着什么东西要爆发出来一般。
同时，被影响到的姜家族人和真界界域种族生灵，他们明显地感觉得到，自己体内的法则运转竟然变得有些凝滞起来。
“唰！唰！唰！”
不论是姜家族人，还是真界界域种族生灵，当即各自心惊地纷纷止战，朝着远处飞走，远离这片区域。
显然，他们都被灭天令，这件超神器展露出来的强大威势，给吓得不轻，以为是有哪位主神在这里动手。
可是等到他们远离之后，回头过后，却是没有感应到有着主神的气息出现。
这是他们方才看向虚空之中那道巨大虚影，还有正在散发着强大的威势的灭天令。
“这是灭天令？”
有姜家族人显得有些不解。
对于灭天令，虽然他们很少看见，却也并不是一无所知。
但是，他们从来都没有看到过，灭天令竟然会是今日这个样子。
此时的灭天令，别说它是一件神器，就是说它是主神的分身，都有人相信。
因为他们感觉，此时灭天令散发出来的威势，比起主神来，也就只是差了一丝罢了。
不过，现在的灭天令比起之前，他们感觉有些似乎出现了很大的变化。
但是，对于灭天令，他们并不是很了解。
因此，他们并不知道，此时的灭天令，已经并不是由他们的族长所掌控。
不过，此时的灭天令爆发出怎么强大的威势来，对于他们姜家来说，却是一件天大的好事。

原本已经显得一片颓败之势的战局，现在因为灭天令的表现，竟然出现了一丝胜利的曙光。
这对于姜家众人来说，不啻于给他们打了一剂强心针。
“这是又有哪位主神参战了吗？”
真界界域各族生灵，看着那显得有些模糊不清的虚影，语气不明地问道。
只是，对于这个问题，在场的所有人，都没人能够回答。
“别去理会，继续战斗！”
“大家都加把劲，姜家之人坚持不了多久了！”
不过，各族真君，还有其他小种族的族长，却是阻止他们继续讨论下，纷纷喊他们继续战斗起来。
哪怕对面再来多一位主神，也是由他们的主神应对，根本不用他们多去关心。
现在他们，还是赶紧完成，他们主神大人交待的任务为好。
而那些原本已经停下战斗的真界界域各族生灵，他们心里稍微一想，就已经明白其中的缘由。
是啊！
哪怕有其他的主神出现，他们的主神大人也自会应付。
没看他现在跟姜望打，都显得是那么的轻松自如吗？
因此，哪怕是再多一位主神前来，他们的主神大人，也应该能够应付才对。
“对！对！趁着现在我们的局势大好，赶紧攻破姜氏界域！”
content_en:
"A gloomy and evil prison, with orders from all directions!"
An angry shout came from Jiang Wu's mouth.
"Boom!"
At this moment, the surrounding void air seemed to be stagnant for a moment, making people feel depressed, as if something was about to burst out.
At the same time, the affected Jiang family and the race creatures in the True Realm clearly felt that the operation of the laws in their bodies had become somewhat stagnant.
"Whoa! Whoa! Whoa!"
Whether it was the Jiang family members or the race creatures from the True Realm, they immediately stopped fighting in fear and flew away into the distance, away from this area.
Obviously, they were all frightened by the powerful power of the Heaven-Destroying Order, this super artifact, and thought that some main god was taking action here.
But after they were far away, when they looked back, they didn't feel the aura of the Lord God appearing.
This is the huge shadow they just looked at in the void, and the Heaven-Destroying Order that was exuding powerful power.
"Is this the Heaven-Destroying Order?"
Some members of the Jiang family looked a little puzzled.
Although they rarely see the Heaven-Destroying Order, they don't know anything about it.
However, they have never seen the Heaven-Destroying Order turning into what it is today.
At this time, some people believe that the Order of Destruction is not only a divine weapon, but also a clone of the Lord God.
Because they felt that the power exuded by the Heaven-Destroying Order at this time was only slightly inferior to that of the Lord God.
However, compared to before, they felt that some of the current Destruction Orders had changed a lot.
However, they don't know much about the Heaven-Destroying Order.
Therefore, they did not know that the Heaven-Destroying Order at this time was no longer controlled by their clan leader.
However, the powerful power that the Heaven-Destroying Order unleashed at this moment was a great blessing for the Jiang family.
The battle situation that originally seemed to be in a state of decline, now there is a glimmer of victory due to the performance of the Heaven-Destroying Order.
For everyone in the Jiang family, this is like a shot in the arm.
"Is there another main god participating in the battle?"
The creatures of all races in the True Realm looked at the vague shadow and asked in an unclear tone.
However, no one present could answer this question.
"Ignore it and keep fighting!"
"Everyone, please work harder, the Jiang family won't be able to hold on much longer!"
However, the true kings of each race and the heads of other small races stopped them from continuing the discussion and called them to continue fighting.
Even if there is another main god on the opposite side, their main god will deal with it, and they don't need to worry about it at all.
Now, they had better hurry up and complete the tasks assigned by their Lord God.
As for the creatures of all races in the True Realm who had stopped fighting, they already understood the reason after thinking about it for a moment.
yes!
Even if other main gods appear, their main god will be able to deal with it.
Didn't you see how relaxed he looked when fighting Jiang Wang?
Therefore, even if one more Lord God comes, their Lord God should be able to handle it.
"Yes! Yes! While we are in a good situation now, hurry up and break through Jiang's realm!"
